p.n: The Rat and the Cat Live Next to a Tree

body.p: the burrow of a rat called Farīdūn.

Hunters frequented that
place, hunting game and fowl there. One day, a huntsman arrived and set his snares near
Rūmī’s place-it wasn’t long before he fell into them.” “The

rat came out creeping, wanting something to eat, yet
cautious of Rūmī. As he was pursuing his search he noticed him in the net; so he was pleased, welcoming the sight He

then turned
and saw behind him a mongoose who wanted to take him, and in the tree an owl who wanted to snatch him. And so he became perplexed about his situation. He feared-
that if he stepped back, the mongoose would take him; that if he moved right or left, the owl would snatch him; and that
